message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has confirmed that none of the slots I identified work for Elena and David. He has offered to send me their calendars, which I previously requested as a next step. Accepting his offer is the most logical action to take. With all four calendars, I can perform a comprehensive search for a common 30-minute slot.

My plan is to:
1.  Acknowledge Brad's message and accept his offer to send the calendars for Elena Soto and David Okafor.
2.  End my session to wait for his response.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
